name: Andrew Clark
source:
Old and wise beyond his years, Andrew makes himself out to be a guide to the young ones. Practicing ethnography in his youth, he settled down to teach psychology when his dear wife passed away. Being Ashton's old professor, he takes interest in his wellbeing and is perhaps a little too keen in the detective's affairs.

[From [url=https://www.castingcall.club/projects/paid-see-submission-guidelines-the-letter-a-horror-visual-novel]Castingcall.club[/url]]
